{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Pest control Banner.png |location =[[Reserve]] |given by =[[Jaeger]] |reward = |previous = |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Come in, have a seat. You know how angry the local scum makes me, especially the damn looters, I can't stand them. Somebody steals from others to survive, but some do it for profit, and there are especially plenty of the latter ones in Tarkov. Take the military base, for example, I've been there before this whole conflict, it was such a beautiful sight: everything is clean, in order, the ground is almost glittering under the sun. And now the whole place is filled with all sorts of scum and marauders. I have a request for you: go there and let those looters know that you have to stay human in any situation.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 10 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Eliminate 10 [[Scavs]] inside the main barracks on [[Reserve]] ==Rewards== * +7,400 [[EXP]] * [[Jaeger]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 20,000 Roubles ** 21,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 23,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 2× [[PAID AntiRoach spray]] * 6× [[Gunpowder "Eagle"]] * 4× [[Pack of nails]] * 2× [[Can of thermite]] {{quote|Is it done? The air almost seems fresher now. It's a pity we couldn't get those looters' heads on straight in another way.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to kill 10 [[Scavs]] inside, or in the close proximity of the black and white pawn barrack buildings. Getting [[Tagged and Cursed|tagged and cursed]] on purpose can help with getting Scavs in the quest area.
